checks.name: Stationary neutral NOS accepts no throttle, full brake and handbrake; adds shaft torque, consumes bottle, and cannot propel a disconnected gearbox
Failed engine still allows NOS valve activation and bottle use, but gets no combustion torque
Forced high-speed first gear is accepted and wheel-driven overrev damages engine and gearbox
Selecting a short gear with clutch open does not damage an uncoupled engine
Reverse while moving is accepted and produces drivetrain reaction instead of a protected selection
Reverse has no artificial road-speed throttle cutoff
Fuel follows SDK injected mass, starvation cuts combustion, and refuel plus starter restores the engine
Localized wheel loss removes real contact forces; respawn and car swaps preserve damage; repair and refuel affect only requested systems
A wheel-less body settles on chassis support and condition survives serialization
Handbrake stall and service-brake burnout still emerge from the coupled drivetrain
